The *Āsavaduka* is an Abhidhamma text cataloged within the *Paṭṭhāna* (*Patthana* 14.13) of the Pali Tipiṭaka. As part of the conditional relations treatises of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka, the text applies the analytical matrix of conditions (*paccaya*) to the dyad (*duka*) concerning the *āsavas* (mental pollutants, defilements, or cankers) [DharmaNexus]. The retrieved secondary literature passages citing the *āsavaduka* focus on the dyad's exposition within the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* rather than providing bibliographic or analytical commentary on this specific *Paṭṭhāna* division.
